rationale: Bus 2 has an undervoltage violation (0.925 pu < 0.95 pu min). To correct this, a voltage increase of 0.025 pu is needed. Given the sensitivity of 0.006 pu/MVar, the required reactive power injection is 0.025 / 0.006 = 4.167 MVar. This action is within the allowed bounds [0, 20] MVar and is the minimum cost solution to fix the violation.
